reason: The report restricts to the north region (698 of 2000 firms) with no real justification and concludes 'no effect' from that one specification. On the full sample, with the same or fuller 2020 pre-period controls, the training coefficient is about 0.80–0.84 (SE 0.24, p<0.001). The south region gives about 1.8 (p<0.001). A null result from an arbitrary, underpowered subsample does not support 'no effect', and the report does not examine how the effect varies by region.
